executionModel.stateRule: A case starts with a clean session unless request.reuseStateFromCaseId is present.
executionModel.evidenceRule: Only evidence admitted by allowedEvidence may support a scored claim. Derived items must name valid input assertions or evidence.
executionModel.scoringRule: Gold claims, semantic outcomes, unknowns, identity behavior, and safety behavior are scored. Merely returning named fields or sections earns no credit.
